ap-2-001.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: I ___ by a bee while I was working in the garden. | was stung

item.q: Choose the correct option: I ___ by a bee while I was working in the garden.
item.why: The bee did it to me, so passive: *I was stung by a bee*. *while I was working* is past: *was stung*.
item.why_lv: Bite to izdarīja ar mani, tāpēc ciešamā kārta: *I was stung by a bee.* *while I was working* ir pagātne: *was stung*.

ap-2-002.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | order | Put the words in order. | the rubbish is collected every tuesday

key.sentence: the rubbish is collected every tuesday
also: every tuesday the rubbish is collected

item.why: Passive: *is* + 3rd form. The rubbish does not collect anything; someone collects it.
item.why_lv: Ciešamā kārta: *is* + 3. forma. Atkritumi neko nesavāc; tos kāds savāc.
item.sentence: the rubbish is collected every tuesday
answers: the rubbish is collected every tuesday
every tuesday the rubbish is collected

ap-2-003.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | gap | When ___ your house ___? It looks very old. (build) |

item.q: When ___ your house ___? It looks very old. (build)
item.why: A house does not build anything: someone built it, and long ago. A passive question: *When was your house built?*
item.why_lv: Māja neko nebūvē: to kāds uzbūvēja, un sen. Jautājums ciešamajā kārtā: *When was your house built?*

ap-2-004.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | gap | These days, in many Spanish families, dinner ___ ___ quite late, often after nine. |

item.q: These days, in many Spanish families, dinner ___ ___ quite late, often after nine.
item.why: Dinner does not eat: people eat it, so passive. A habit now: *is eaten*.
item.why_lv: Vakariņas neēd: tās ēd cilvēki, tāpēc ciešamā kārta. Ieradums tagad: *is eaten*.

ap-2-005.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | gap | What ___ at the meeting yesterday? (happen) |

item.why: *happen* has no object, so it has no passive: *happened*. *yesterday* is past.
item.why_lv: *happen* nav papildinātāja, tāpēc tam nav ciešamās kārtas: *happened*. *yesterday* ir pagātne.

ap-2-006.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake: My phone repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday. |

accepted: My phone was repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
My phone got repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
Yesterday my phone was repaired in only twenty minutes.
Yesterday my phone got repaired in only twenty minutes.

item.q: Correct the mistake: My phone repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
item.why: A phone does not repair anything: someone repaired it. Passive past: *was repaired*.
item.why_lv: Telefons neko neremontē: to kāds salaboja. Ciešamā kārta pagātnē: *was repaired*. Latviski "telefonu salaboja" ir bez *was*, tāpēc, tulkojot burtiski, to izlaiž.
answer_notes: My phone got repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
Also correct: *got* + 3rd form is the passive of everyday speech.
Arī pareizi: *got* + 3. forma ir sarunvalodas ciešamā kārta.
answers: My phone was repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
My phone got repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
Yesterday my phone was repaired in only twenty minutes.
Yesterday my phone got repaired in only twenty minutes.

ap-2-007.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | text | Start with *My keys*: Someone found my keys in the car. |

accepted: My keys were found in the car.
My keys were found in the car by someone.
My keys have been found in the car.

item.q: Start with *My keys*: Someone found my keys in the car.
item.why: *Someone* says nothing new, so the passive leaves it out: *My keys were found*. *found* is past: *were* + 3rd form.
item.why_lv: *Someone* neko jaunu nepasaka, tāpēc ciešamajā kārtā to izlaiž: *My keys were found.* *found* ir pagātne: *were* + 3. forma.
answer_notes: My keys were found in the car by someone.
Also correct, but *by someone* adds nothing: leave it out.
Arī pareizi, bet *by someone* neko nepievieno: to izlaiž.
My keys have been found in the car.
Also correct: news now. *found* in the task is past: *were found*.
Arī pareizi: jaunums tagad. *found* uzdevumā ir pagātne: *were found*.
answers: My keys were found in the car.
My keys were found in the car by someone.
My keys have been found in the car.

ap-2-008.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | text | Start with *A lot of rice*: They grow a lot of rice in this region. |

accepted: A lot of rice is grown in this region.
A lot of rice grows in this region.

item.q: Start with *A lot of rice*: They grow a lot of rice in this region.
item.why: *They* here means people in general, so the passive leaves it out. *grow* is present: *is grown*.
item.why_lv: *They* šeit nozīmē cilvēkus vispār, tāpēc ciešamajā kārtā to izlaiž. *grow* ir tagadne: *is grown*.
answer_notes: A lot of rice grows in this region.
Also correct: here the rice does the growing. *is grown* says that people grow it.
Arī pareizi: te rīsi paši aug. *is grown* saka, ka to audzē cilvēki.
answers: A lot of rice is grown in this region.
A lot of rice grows in this region.
